If physical stores have been your main channel and your online presence was almost a box ticking after thought, you have a problem when suddenly your website is the only means by which people can buy from you. AI-based algorithms analyze that historic data as well as online purchase and browsing behavior, and then they automatically recommend the right product to the right shopper at the right time. Recommendations can also be delivered through outbound channels, driving your customers, including those who've never shopped online with you before, to your website.
